_comment: Omission-fill rule v2 parameter lock (task gap-omission-fill-sweep-and-lock-params; ownership moved to server/ by task gap-omission-fill-params-owned-by-server). `python3 -I replay_rule.py --check` reads the `chosen` parameters from `server/modules/voice-realtime/omission-fill-params.json` (shipped with the build, so production never depends on this directory) and the thresholds + frozen connection list below. The connection list is frozen: it does not grow when new journals appear, otherwise the AC readings would drift.
rule: voice-realtime-omission-fill-SPEC.md v2 (+ silence confirmation, see the shipped chosen.silence_ms)

reasons.h_ms: 12 s unchanged: every H < 12 either pushes raw recogniser text past 15% or fills-latency past the cap. The sweep shows H=4/6/8 have no feasible row at all.
reasons.g_ms: 1 s (was 3 s). The sweep in {1,2,3,5} produced IDENTICAL fill/duplicate/loss counts on every connection (checked per connection), so the smaller grace lowers p50 from 7.20 s (G=3) to 5.20 s with no measured cost.
reasons.score_t: 0.25: the baseline. 0.15 fills more (raw 14.4%+); 0.35 is not better on duplicates/losses.
reasons.w_min: 7 (≈7 CJK chars / 4 latin words). 6 fills short fragments that are mostly not real omissions; 8 raises LOST>=7 toward 3%.
reasons.numeral_mode: runs2 — strip only runs of >=2 numeral characters, so a lone 一/二/3 survives (一些/一下 stay words). Measured against 'all' (delete every CJK numeral) and 'quantifier' (only before measure words): runs2 gives 82 fills / 13 duplicates (2.2%) / LOST>=7 1.9%; 'all' gives 80 / 14 (2.4%) / 2.4%; 'quantifier' gives 81 / 14 (2.4%) / 2.2%. runs2 wins on both duplicate and loss counts at +2 fills (still 14.1% <= 15%).
reasons.silence_ms: 3 s: the latency fix required by the goal. Originally p50 = p90 = H = 12 s because a majority of fills wait the full hard cap. Waiting H is only needed when the model MIGHT still overwrite the utterance; if the model has been completely silent and the user has not started speaking again, no later model message about newer speech is coming, so the omission is confirmed at t+S. Sweep: p50 drops 12.0 s -> 7.2 s with the fill/duplicate/loss counts IDENTICAL (same items filled, same carried set) — the branch changes only T_i, never the fill set.
reasons.delay_p50_max_ms: 12000 = H, i.e. exactly the AC-398 outer bound (p50 < H). The check also asserts the strict inequality; the measured p50 is 7.2 s.
reasons.connections: The 47 continuous-mode connections present on 2026-10-18 when the lock was written (>=2 finals and >=1 executed message). Frozen so later Live Voice sessions cannot move the AC readings.

baseline_2026_10_18.note: same corpus that produced the SPEC table (v2 without the silence branch: raw 13.7%, duplicate 2.4%, LOST>=7 2.4%, fill delay p50 = p90 = 12 s)
